name: NanoClaw
description: AI assistant that runs agents in isolated per-session Linux containers and bridges them to messaging apps (WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Matrix, Gmail) plus a local CLI. Built on Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK; OpenAI Codex, OpenCode (OpenRouter/Google/DeepSeek), and local Ollama models are pluggable via post-install skills.

notes.text: After install, run the interactive setup wizard: 'pct enter <CT_ID>' then 'machinectl shell nanoclaw@' then 'cd nanoclaw && bash nanoclaw.sh'. The wizard pairs your first channel (WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Matrix, Gmail, or local CLI) and registers your Anthropic credential. Note: 'machinectl shell' is required (not 'su -') so the systemd user session has DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS / XDG_RUNTIME_DIR populated for the NanoClaw verify step.
Updates are handled inside the running chat session — send '/update-nanoclaw' to your NanoClaw agent. Do not run the helper-script update from the Proxmox host.
